title: Public Pathway Consolidation v3: separated transport, cognition, recurrence, and experiential compression
summary: PPC3 preserves one THINK/DREAM model and one SLEEP write path while closing the v2 identification gaps: complete visibility bytes, opaque IDs, exact charges and lifecycle, domain-canonical roots, local-atom-only pathways, true recurrence removal, a full READ/DECIDE/ACT component matrix, reader-only transport isolation, expanded baselines, canonical shuffles/cuts/twins, exact resource promotion, repeated mediation, independent life resets, and a prospective PCFL-Schema rung before compression claims. Parenting remains a future acceleration study.
system_thesis: A fixed base model can acquire prospective competence from its own life when recurrent public THINK operations create action-conditioned experience, DREAM reconciles finite causally available working context without creating evidence, and SLEEP alone compiles publicly supported local records and operation pathways into a per-life LoRA. The experiment separately identifies transport, decision-policy adaptation, action imitation, adaptive retrieval, recurrent computation, pathway binding, continual mediation, capacity, and learned lossy schema compression; it does not infer them from a bundled performance gain.

nodes.before: Recurrent public cognition with incompletely separated component credit.
nodes.after: One charged typed public operation per call with exact state, fingerprint, debit, failure, branch, and recurrence semantics.
nodes.rationale: Thinking remains one loop, but scientific attribution requires executable public transitions.

nodes.before: Typed requested reconciliation with ambiguous identifier and trigger boundaries.
nodes.after: Same-model provisional context reconciliation, requested through opaque eligible record IDs; no automatic trigger, evidence creation, acting, or durable publication.
nodes.rationale: Dream should manage conscious context without laundering answers into sleep.

nodes.before: Support-gated runtime-row writing with a partial treatment ladder.
nodes.after: Only durable writer: canonical-root admission, local atoms, complete component matrix, exact lifecycle, cumulative clean-base LoRA publication.
nodes.rationale: The paper's hard mechanism is whether writing makes later cognition better without poisoning it.

nodes.after: A separate reader-only LoRA process returns one typed record to an unchanged base thinker in the fixed-corpus transport assay.
nodes.rationale: Otherwise READ-LoRA can alter the thinker and transport is not identified.

nodes.after: Prospective unseen-composition rung with episodic-detail and schema-utility probes.
nodes.rationale: Stream capacity alone cannot establish learned lossy compression.

nodes.after: Separately gated acceleration and outgrowability study after basic teachability is demonstrated.
nodes.rationale: Parenting is scientifically strong but would confound the first mechanism assay.

edges.before: Context pressure or request could invoke reconciliation.
edges.after: Only charged typed REQUEST_DREAM over allocated visible record IDs invokes one provisional reconciliation.
edges.rationale: Makes trigger, cost, and causal prefix testable.

edges.before: Dream influenced candidate selection and working structure.
edges.after: Dream may select public roots but never supplies positive target bytes; rows regenerate from roots and exact causal prefixes.
Only a separately sealed schema rung can upgrade capacity/retention evidence to learned-compression evidence.
edges.rationale: Aligns the strongest claim with the missing intervention.

loops.after: Exact charged state machine with one op per call, prediction before ACT, opaque IDs, deterministic backtrack/repeat rules, no invisible retries, and explicit OPEN_LOOP removal.
loops.trigger: One current-item public state is available and call budget remains.
loops.stop_condition: STOP, DEFER, exhausted budget, provider failure, integrity failure, or closed item.
loops.rationale: Identifies recurrent computation rather than merely adaptive retrieval.

loops.after: One charged request over opaque eligible record IDs yields at most one provisional workspace replacement; closure overflow fails without truncation.
loops.trigger: Legal REQUEST_DREAM with visible unresolved records and remaining dream allowance.
loops.stop_condition: Publication, closure overflow, parse/illegal failure, provider failure, or dream budget exhaustion.
loops.rationale: Dream becomes learned context-management behavior while remaining non-evidentiary.

loops.before: Evidence-admitted causal rows train cumulative LoRA.
loops.after: Canonical roots and local atoms generate a sealed READ/DECIDE/ACT row universe; exact component cells and baselines train from clean base and publish atomically.
loops.trigger: A predeclared developmental boundary with sealed public source history.
loops.stop_condition: Atomic cold mount, no eligible rows, failed sleep preserving prior adapter, or integrity failure.
loops.rationale: Separates write quality from inference and prevents partial or unsupported learning.

loops.before: Repeated acquisition, sleep, publication, and evaluation.
loops.after: At least three successive prospectively bound cycles with separate memory, observation, path, and mount interventions; PCFL-Stream and PCFL-Schema claims remain distinct.
loops.trigger: N_ACQ new sealed independent roots are complete.
loops.stop_condition: Maximum cycles, futility, integrity failure, or prospectively defined saturation rule.
loops.rationale: The paper concerns improvement across a life, not one batch update.

claims.before: PATH improvement could support connected recurrent pathway use.
claims.after: Public pathways add value only if PATH beats matched endpoint, shuffle, one-shot-query, open-loop, component, and strong external-memory controls and loses the registered gain under decisive cuts.
claims.evidence_needed: Full component matrix, authentic path interventions, recurrence removal, and independent postrun audit.

claims.after: LoRA transports supported local records only if reader-only mounting changes typed READ fidelity while exact thinker bytes and weights remain fixed.
claims.evidence_needed: Fixed-corpus TEXT_READ versus isolated READ-LoRA probes and mount/byte receipts.

claims.after: A per-life system learns prospectively only if prior memory changes epistemic action, the new observation enters a later sleep, a later path uses it, and later action value changes across repeated independent cycles.
claims.evidence_needed: Separate memory, sham-observation, path-cut, and adapter-mount interventions across independent lives.

claims.after: Learned lossy compression is available only on PCFL-Schema when fixed adapter bytes preserve held-out schema/action utility as sufficient-statistic information grows while irrelevant episodic detail is not retained.
claims.evidence_needed: Prospective schema split, detail reconstruction probe, matched text/graph controls, rank/byte response surface, and shuffle/cut effects.

claims.before: Fixed-rank PCFL-Stream capacity could be called learned compression.
claims.after: PCFL-Stream supports only continual acquisition, retention, cross-era composition, capacity, and storage-efficiency claims.
claims.evidence_needed: PCFL-Schema is required for compression language.

claims.before: Parenting could enter the first mechanism run.
claims.after: Parenting remains a future learning-acceleration/outgrowability experiment after unparented teachability is established.
claims.evidence_needed: Separate directive, leakage audit, wrong-parent control, generation transfer, and ratification.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate each formal byte class at every stage; fuzz model-proposed identifiers and record types; rebuild all allowlisted prompts, DREAM slices, retrieval requests, and rows.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every forbidden mutation is byte-inert; same-item permitted changes are local; all exposed IDs are harness-issued, eligible, opaque, and freshly remapped.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Completeness of visibility closure and resistance to identifier/selection laundering.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust legal and illegal operations, branch ties, repeat fingerprints, all debit cases, closure overflow, provider timing, item states, sleep failure, atomic publication, and exact resume.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each fixture has one deterministic next state, cost, status, and surviving adapter; no retry, ambiguous sibling, partial mount, or uncharged attempt exists.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Executable THINK/DREAM/SLEEP semantics and lifecycle safety.

acceptance_tests.setup: Cover repeated compiler replays, multi-measurements, near duplicates, PCFL confirmations/twins/regenerations, diamonds/cycles, disjoint support, and two full life resets.
acceptance_tests.expected: Canonical root-family maps agree across independent implementations; descendants never add support; every life-local artifact/cache/RNG namespace resets.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Independent evidence accounting or independent-life statistics.

acceptance_tests.setup: Seed witnessed atoms, composite shortcuts, final mappings, target IDs, dream prose, synthetic outcomes, and future-prefix actions into writer candidates.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only witnessed local atoms and exact public operation transitions survive; each decisive path has at least two edges and registered cut/twin/null counterfactuals.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That PATH requires connected traversal rather than shortcut or answer memorization.

acceptance_tests.setup: Reconstruct all eight READ/DECIDE/ACT cells and fixed-corpus TEXT_READ/reader-only READ-LoRA calls with mount and thinker hash tracing.
acceptance_tests.expected: Cells differ only by registered row families; reader LoRA is absent from THINK/ACT; returned bytes and base thinker bytes are otherwise identical.

acceptance_tests.setup: Serialize every mandatory baseline and treatment under the primary active-byte caps and secondary full-cost ledger.
acceptance_tests.expected: Interfaces, truncation, active bytes, dtype, indices, calls, reads, actions, tokens, candidate work, caches, training, and publication are exact and prospectively comparable.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Baseline fairness or LoRA-specific promotion under the declared resource view.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use deterministic scripted policies where only adaptive query, only recurrent post-return reasoning, or neither can solve the fixture; execute PATH, ONE_SHOT_QUERY, and OPEN_LOOP contracts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each contrast changes only its named mechanism and the scripted metric responds in the registered direction.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Constructibility and sensitivity of recurrence/adaptive-retrieval contrasts, not their scientific effect.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run manifest-seeded degree-preserving shuffles, PCFL twin transformations, bridge/binding/null cuts, and Compiler split/near-duplicate checks against independent oracles.
acceptance_tests.expected: Marginals and budgets are preserved, decisive bindings are destroyed, no replacement path survives, twin bytes/expected swaps match, and splits remain independent.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Authenticity of pathway interventions or target sealing.

acceptance_tests.setup: Two separately authored no-import sealers build source/target/twin/cut manifests and record source hashes.
acceptance_tests.expected: They agree byte-for-byte on target artifacts and canonical relations while satisfying all disjointness, shortcut, classifier, and standard-agent development ceilings.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Independent target construction and shortcut resistance.

acceptance_tests.setup: Simulate at least four developmental cycles with correct/wrong/null memory, included/sham observation, intact/cut path, mounted/unmounted adapter, failures, and missing cells.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exact cycle order and each independent intervention preserve matched row/token exposure; only the scripted causal chain moves the synthetic outcome.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Constructibility of the complete mediated-flywheel estimand, not its real effect.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze PCFL-Stream and prospective PCFL-Schema generators, held-out compositions, detail probes, rank/byte grid, new/old/cross-era panels, and literal claim map.
acceptance_tests.expected: Stream cannot unlock compression; schema targets never enter acquisition; every capacity, retention, transfer, and compression statement has a distinct hard falsifier.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Claim-to-instrument alignment for long-life and learned-compression results.

acceptance_tests.setup: An independent statistician/reviewer recomputes sample-size or simulation power, co-primary error control, life-level estimator, effect thresholds, variance source, CI, missingness, futility, and extension rules.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every numeric criterion passes a predeclared minimum before any sealed model result is opened; otherwise the run remains a pilot.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Adequacy of the prospective confirmatory design, not the scientific hypothesis.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inject failed construct/science gates and attempt writer, metric, threshold, target, treatment, split, and analysis changes or target reuse.
acceptance_tests.expected: The negative result remains registered and every redesign requires a new change ID, targets, seals, review, and ratification.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Durable negative-result handling and protection against revealed-target tuning.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh reviewer and advocate bind implementation, T01-T13, exact model/run manifest, canary scope, resources, stop rules, and claim map after current no-model work completes.
acceptance_tests.expected: No current artifact self-authorizes a model call; only a later exact human-ratified manifest may run a non-science canary or science.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Scientific closure, proportionality, or execution authority.

acceptance_tests.setup: Two fresh-context interpretations, adversarial cross-critique, adjudicated consensus, and exact human ratification bind this proposal before implementation.
acceptance_tests.expected: Consensus either recommends the exact scoped proposal or produces another hash-bound rework; implementation remains forbidden until exact human ratification.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Architecture-level consensus or authority for current implementation.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh reviewer recomputes actual visibility, prefixes, roots, rows, component cells, baselines, resources, recurrence, cuts, mediation, schema, statistics, lifecycle, and ordered event suffix.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only passing literal results and claims are released; integrity or estimator failure suppresses unsupported reporting.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Every reported scientific mechanism and headline conclusion.
